stories.title: Unit 42 Uncovers PEERSTITCH, a Stealthy FortiGate Implant
stories.abstract: Attackers leveraged CVE-2024-47575 to compromise over 500 FortiGate firewalls, specifically targeting a telecommunications firm. The campaign utilized a memory-resident ARM64 implant dubbed PEERSTITCH to maintain persistent, stealthy access within the affected network infrastructure.
stories.why: This highlights active exploitation of a critical vulnerability to deploy sophisticated, memory-resident malware against high-value telecommunications targets.
stories.action: Patch all FortiGate devices immediately to address CVE-2024-47575.

stories.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploited BeyondTrust Zero-Day to Take Over Remote Support Servers
stories.abstract: Multiple critical vulnerabilities have been identified in Redis software and BeyondTrust Remote Support. Notably, CVE-2026-25243 in Redis and CVE-2026-102764 in BeyondTrust are currently being exploited in the wild, with the latter added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
stories.why: Active exploitation of authentication bypass and remote code execution flaws in infrastructure software poses a high risk of unauthorized access and system compromise.
stories.action: Update Redis and BeyondTrust Remote Support to the latest patched versions immediately.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit Plex2Shell Flaws to Install Crypto Miners and Linux Proxy Backdoor
stories.abstract: Attackers are actively exploiting a four-vulnerability chain dubbed Plex2Shell in Plex Media Server. The flaw allows remote code execution, which threat actors are currently using to install cryptocurrency miners and establish persistent Linux proxy backdoors on compromised systems.
stories.why: Unpatched Plex servers are being weaponized for botnet activity and unauthorized resource consumption shortly after public disclosure of the exploit chain.
stories.action: Restrict Plex Media Server network access and monitor for unauthorized outbound traffic or unexpected resource usage.

stories.title: ConnectWise Suspends Cloud Backup After Attackers Compromise Microsoft 365 Tenants
Popular WordPress SEO Plugin Rank Math PRO Hijacked to Deliver Self-Restoring Backdoor
stories.abstract: A supply chain compromise of the Rank Math PRO WordPress plugin resulted in malicious code being distributed via official channels for approximately eleven hours. The infected update installs a persistent, self-restoring backdoor on affected websites, necessitating a full forensic review of compromised environments.
stories.why: This incident demonstrates a successful supply chain attack against a widely used plugin, granting attackers persistent administrative access to WordPress installations.
stories.action: Restore sites from clean backups and rotate all administrative credentials and API keys immediately.

stories.title: Ivanti ICS Zero-Day Attacks Highlight Vendor Patching Hurdles
stories.abstract: Ivanti has confirmed active exploitation of multiple vulnerabilities across Connect Secure, Neurons Patch for Intune, and Xtraction products. One of these flaws, an authentication bypass and remote code execution vulnerability, is currently listed on CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
stories.why: These vulnerabilities allow unauthenticated remote code execution, providing attackers a direct path to compromise critical enterprise infrastructure and internal networks.
stories.action: Apply the latest security patches for Ivanti Connect Secure, Neurons Patch for Intune, and Xtraction immediately.

stories.title: Critical PwnEscape Linux Kernel Vulnerability Lets Guest VMs Read Host Memory
stories.abstract: A critical vulnerability, CVE-2026-99999, has been identified in the Linux kernel's networking subsystem. This flaw enables a guest virtual machine to bypass isolation boundaries and read sensitive memory directly from the underlying host system.
stories.why: This represents a significant cross-tenant risk for cloud environments, potentially allowing attackers to exfiltrate data from other virtual machines or the host itself.
stories.action: Apply the latest Linux kernel security patches as soon as they are released by your distribution.

stories.title: Google security advisory (AV26-1060)
stories.abstract: Multiple vendors have released security updates addressing critical vulnerabilities. Affected products include Google Chrome, Progress MOVEit Transfer, and Palo Alto Networks Idira Secrets Manager. One Chrome vulnerability is currently being exploited in the wild, necessitating immediate attention for browser and server infrastructure.
stories.why: Exploitation of browser and file transfer vulnerabilities poses significant risks to endpoint integrity and sensitive data exfiltration.
stories.action: Update Chrome to 155.0.8059.84 or later, and patch MOVEit and Idira Secrets Manager immediately.

stories.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
GhostAction Attackers Plant Credential Stealer Disguised as Font in 94 GitHub Repositories
stories.abstract: Threat actors known as GhostAction are targeting GitHub repositories by embedding credential-stealing malware within deceptive font files. This campaign represents an evolution in their tactics, moving beyond malicious workflow injections to actively compromise open-source projects and harvest developer credentials.
stories.why: This indicates a sophisticated supply chain threat targeting developer environments and CI/CD pipelines to facilitate credential theft and potential downstream code poisoning.

stories.title: Bullhorn takes staffing platform offline to contain cyberattack
stories.abstract: Staffing software provider Bullhorn has suspended access to its platform following a security breach. The company took systems offline to isolate the incident and prevent further unauthorized activity, resulting in a widespread service outage for its clients.
stories.why: Supply chain attacks on specialized SaaS platforms can disrupt operations for thousands of downstream businesses and expose sensitive candidate or payroll data.

stories.title: Drupal Patches Critical Field UI Flaw With Unauthenticated RCE Path via Contributed Modules
stories.abstract: Drupal has patched a critical remote code execution vulnerability affecting the Field UI module. While the core installation is not directly exploitable, specific contributed modules create attack vectors that allow unauthenticated adversaries to execute arbitrary code on the underlying server.
stories.why: Remote code execution in a content management system is a high-severity risk that can lead to full site compromise and data exfiltration.
stories.action: Update Drupal to versions 11.4.10, 11.3.19, or 10.6.19 immediately.

stories.title: Ahold Delhaize confirms 'malicious actions' behind cyber outages affecting grocery brands
OnlyFans Copyright Takedowns Expose Compromised Websites
PEERSTITCH Malware Deployed via FortiOS Flaw Bypasses Checks on Tagged VPN Sessions
OpenCode Console Breach May Have Exposed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API Keys
How a Massive Chinese Crime Ring Hacked Staples to Steal Millions
Huge DMV data breach impacted current and former Florida residents
stories.abstract: Florida officials have confirmed a significant data breach affecting the state's Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles. The incident, attributed to the threat actor group ShinyHunters, has compromised the personal information of numerous current and former residents.
stories.why: Large-scale exfiltration of government-held identity data increases the risk of targeted phishing, identity theft, and downstream credential stuffing attacks against affected individuals.

stories.title: Citizen Lab Traces Zero-Click Candiru Spyware Infections at Al Jazeera to Targeted Online Ads
Conduent Agrees to Pay $80m to Settle Data Breach Class Action
CISA Adds One Known Exploited Vulnerability to Catalog
stories.abstract: CISA has officially added CVE-2026-21589 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. This flaw affects various Atlassian products and allows unauthorized external parties to access sensitive files or directories, creating a significant risk for organizations using these tools.
stories.why: Active exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data access and potential system compromise within Atlassian environments.
stories.action: Review Atlassian security advisories and apply available patches for affected products immediately.

stories.title: Hackers steal customer data from major Russian hosting provider FirstVDS
Siemens Software Center Vulnerability Exploited in ClickFix Malware Attacks
stories.abstract: Threat actors are leveraging a legitimate, digitally signed Siemens Software Center binary to facilitate DLL side-loading attacks. By pairing this trusted application with malicious libraries, attackers bypass security defenses to deploy malware through deceptive ClickFix social engineering prompts on Windows systems.
stories.why: Attackers are increasingly abusing trusted, signed software to evade endpoint detection and bypass application control policies.
stories.action: Monitor for unauthorized DLL loading and restrict execution of Siemens Software Center in high-risk environments.

stories.title: One Compromised Login Exposed Millions of California Students’ Records
ConnectWise turns off its SaaS-y backup, security, and management services to probe security SNAFU
stories.abstract: ConnectWise has suspended several cloud services following reports of unauthorized access to Microsoft 365 environments. Security researchers suggest attackers may have compromised client accounts using stolen session tokens, potentially granting them broad administrative control over affected tenant infrastructures.
stories.why: Compromised MSP management tools provide attackers with high-privilege access to downstream client networks, facilitating widespread ransomware deployment or data exfiltration.
stories.action: Review M365 logs for anomalous logins and rotate credentials or session tokens for integrated service accounts.

stories.title: US Cybersecurity Job Postings Fall 26% as AI Security Engineer Demand Soars
stories.abstract: US cybersecurity job listings dropped by 26% year-over-year, reaching a four-year low. While overall demand has cooled, hiring for specialized roles like AI security engineers remains robust, even as executive-level positions such as CISOs and directors face significant declines.
stories.why: The shift indicates a maturing market prioritizing specific technical skill sets over general leadership roles, potentially impacting long-term organizational security strategy and talent retention.

stories.title: Palo Alto Networks Patches PAN-OS Authenticated RCE Flaw Amid Active Exploitation
stories.abstract: Palo Alto Networks has released security patches for a high-severity remote code execution vulnerability in the PAN-OS management interface. The flaw, identified as CVE-2026-0322, is currently being actively exploited in the wild.
stories.why: Management interface vulnerabilities provide attackers with a direct path to compromise network infrastructure and gain administrative control over security appliances.
stories.action: Update PAN-OS to the latest patched version immediately.

stories.title: AhsayCBS Flaws Exploited to Deploy Web Shells Get New Fixes After Incomplete Patches
stories.abstract: Ahsay Backup released patches for two critical vulnerabilities in AhsayCBS, CVE-2026-105133 and CVE-2026-105134. Attackers previously exploited these flaws to bypass authentication, execute arbitrary code, and install web shells or cryptocurrency miners. These updates address previous incomplete remediation efforts.
stories.why: These vulnerabilities are actively exploited in the wild to gain remote code execution and establish persistence via web shells.
stories.action: Update AhsayCBS to the latest version immediately.

stories.title: Fake Web3 Accelerator Uses npm Packages to Spread Malware and Hijack AI Agent Traffic
OpenCode hack exposes API keys amid AI distillation attacks
stories.abstract: The OpenCode AI project suffered a security breach that resulted in the unauthorized exposure of user-provided API keys for external services. The incident affected a limited subset of the platform's user base.
stories.why: Exposed API keys provide attackers with unauthorized access to third-party services, potentially leading to data theft, financial loss, or further infrastructure compromise.
stories.action: Revoke and rotate any API keys previously configured within the OpenCode platform.

stories.title: Inside the Underground Market for Know Your Client Services
stories.abstract: Cybercriminals are increasingly offering specialized services to circumvent identity verification protocols. These underground markets provide forged documentation, AI-generated deepfakes, and real-time assistance to help malicious actors successfully pass Know Your Client checks and establish fraudulent accounts on various platforms.
stories.why: These services lower the barrier for entry for fraud, money laundering, and account takeovers, undermining the efficacy of standard identity verification systems.

stories.title: BeyondTrust Remote Support Zero-Day Continues Trend of Exploited Edge Bugs
A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
stories.abstract: A threat actor successfully compromised over 100 websites, including major corporations like John Deere and SharkNinja, by deploying autonomous AI agents. These automated tools facilitated the unauthorized access, highlighting a shift toward scalable, machine-driven exploitation techniques in modern cyberattacks.
stories.why: This demonstrates the practical application of autonomous agents in scaling reconnaissance and exploitation, significantly lowering the barrier for large-scale corporate network intrusions.

stories.title: The Staples Gift Card Heist
⚡ Weekly Recap: 98 Zero-Days, Rogue AI Agents, $100M Crypto Theft, 700 Supermarkets Hit and More
stories.abstract: The past week saw a surge in security incidents, including widespread zero-day vulnerabilities, significant cryptocurrency theft, and large-scale operational disruptions affecting retail infrastructure. These events highlight persistent risks stemming from compromised trusted services, insecure hardware, and the exploitation of legacy software flaws.
stories.why: These incidents demonstrate how supply chain weaknesses and unpatched legacy systems continue to facilitate large-scale data breaches and financial losses.

F5 releases out-of-band patches for critical NGINX vulnerabilities
Police Say Scammers Used AI to Clone a Sheriff’s Voice
Exploited Vulnerabilities Typically Take Three Months to Patch, Moody’s Finds
stories.abstract: A recent analysis from Moody's indicates that organizations require a median of 87 days to remediate security vulnerabilities that are already being actively exploited in the wild.
stories.why: This significant delay highlights a critical window of exposure, demonstrating that current patch management cycles are failing to keep pace with active threats.
